city.name: London
city.description: London is the capital city of England. It is the most populous city in the United Kingdom, with a metropolitan area of over 13 million inhabitants.
city.details: Standing on the River Thames, London has been a major settlement for two millennia, its history going back to its founding by the Romans, who named it Londinium.

city.name: Paris
city.description: Paris is the capital of France. It is known for its art, gastronomy, and culture.
city.details: The city is crossed by the River Seine and is famous for landmarks such as the Eiffel Tower and the Louvre Museum.

city.name: Tokyo
city.description: Tokyo is the capital of Japan and one of the most populated metropolitan areas in the world.
city.details: Originally a small fishing village named Edo, Tokyo has grown into a global center for technology, culture, and finance.
